'''Oraalarri the Elder''' was an [[Albino/Legends|albino]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who sought to spread the ideals of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. He was an elder within his four person family.

==Biography==
[[File:EndorFamily.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Oraalarri's family's home on Endor]]
{{Quote|Hopefully this day brings you closer to freedom and to harmony and to peace. May you hold Life Day as dear as we do.|Oraalarri|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
During the Life Day festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Oraalarri resided on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] with his family. [[Kkatamik]] sent a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to visit Oraalarri and his family so that they could learn more about the festival. His family included [[Anarra]], [[Radrrl]] and [[Tebeurra]].

Oraalarri would have the celebrants speak to his family. As a sign of goodwill, Oraalarri offered Life Day celebrants a painting.

==Behind the scenes==
Oraalarri the Elder was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During the Life Day event of [[2004]], players could talk to Oraalarri on either Endor or Yavin 4. Oraalarri would then have the players speak to the rest of his family to learn about Life Day. Once the player's learned everything they could, Oraalarri would give the player a random Life Day painting.
